primary_result.statement: The additive LR action produces a zero-order Euler mass. Its cancelling algebraic partner is not the geometric L2 adjoint of the retained Lorentzian operator; the positive square retains a normal first-order mass cross term. Hence the companion bulk-L2 V criterion cannot consume only the raw mass norm or the algebraically cancelling partner.
